name: ironbox
description: IRONBOX 1.0 — offline Android virtual assistant with replaceable MP4 animations, SQLite + FTS5 dialogue, speech recognition and TTS

scripts.sync: npm run prepare:assets && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run prepare:assets && npm run db:build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run prepare:assets && npm run db:build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run db:validate && npm run videos:validate
scripts.db:build:full: node tools/generate-database.js --count 1000000 --output build/corpus.jsonl && node tools/import-database.js && node tools/import-database.js --input build/corpus.jsonl --append --no-fallbacks
scripts.build:apk:full: npm run prepare:assets && npm run db:build:full && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
